blocking.title: A tracked file contains a literal em dash (section 9 rule 12: no em dashes anywhere)
blocking.evidence: `git ls-files -z | xargs -0 grep -c $'\xe2\x80\x94'` over all 313 tracked files finds exactly one U+2014 character, in tests/test_e2.py line 168, in the assertion `assert "## Adjacent pairs" in md and "Excluded entries" in md and "<U+2014>" not in md` (added in 12f1161). Rule 12 of docs/BUILD_BRIEF.md section 9 (copied verbatim into CLAUDE.md) says 'No em dashes anywhere'. No gate catches it, because G13 scans only README.md and docs/REPORT.md. Fix without touching src/ (safe while G6 runs): write the character as the escape "\u2014", as tools/ship_check.py already does with chr(0x2014).

non_blocking.title: G12 can never pass in this environment: it reads the last line of stdout plus stderr
non_blocking.detail: tools/ship_check.py:1202 requires tail(res.out) == 'REVIEW: SHIP', but res.out is stdout then stderr and uv prints a UV_NATIVE_TLS deprecation warning on stderr, so the last line is that warning (reproduced with `uv run --no-sync python -c "print('REVIEW: SHIP')"` in the fresh clone; the same warning is why G10's evidence shows a uv warning instead of the PASS lines); compare the last line of res.stdout instead, before the final sequence.

non_blocking.title: Marginal rank intervals use the other entry's critical value for the best-rank side
non_blocking.detail: In src/evalstats/rank.py:152-162 with simultaneous=False, 'j surely better than i' uses crit[j] while entry i's marginal set needs crit[i] for all of i's comparisons; the banked marginal_best fields in artifacts/e2/*/results.json reproduce the library rule, and 10 of 66 TB2 and 2 of 32 Epoch marginal intervals change under the own-critical-value rule; they are secondary and appear in no document, and rank.py is in ANALYSIS_CODE, so a fix waits for the end of E1 or needs an analysis-code amendment of 0004.

non_blocking.title: docs/REPORT.md says G6 and E0 part 2 have not run while G6 is running
non_blocking.detail: docs/REPORT.md line 5 ('frozen and have not run') and the table row at line 24 ('frozen, not run') predate the G6 run that started 2026-11-11T20:19Z with raw rows committed, while README.md says the validation runs are under way; reword to 'running, not banked'.

non_blocking.title: E3 robust counts are shown as key results without an unvalidated label
non_blocking.detail: README.md:104 and the REPORT abstract give the robust counts (0 and 3), whose Imbens and Manski interval for a pair difference has no E0 cell (prereg 0001 Methods 6 asks headline intervals to pass E0), and README.md:75-76 says the methods behind E2 and E3 carry a validity record; the gap is disclosed in Limitations and Method but should sit next to the counts.

non_blocking.title: The post-result [0, 1] cut of the policy-bounds interval is not listed as a deviation
non_blocking.detail: Commit f86413f (D-035 item 6) changed a prereg 0001 estimator after E2 and E3 were banked and re-banked them; CORRECTIONS.md and the Method section record it, but docs/REPORT.md 'Deviations from preregistration' (lines 184-190) omits it and ends 'No other amendment of prereg/0001 or prereg/0003 exists'.

non_blocking.title: G6 trusts the artifact's planted values and does not tie recovery.json to the raw rows
non_blocking.detail: tools/ship_check.py g6 (lines 869-932) recounts coverage against each row's own 'planted' field and never compares recovery.json with the committed artifacts/g6/raw.jsonl; it could require the constant truths from the recovery-config block (task 4.0, model:task 0.5, model 0.24) and dataset-by-dataset equality with the raw rows (the 88 raw rows checked here carry the right constants).

non_blocking.title: G5 does not tie E0 raw lines to their cell's seeds or to one analysis code
non_blocking.detail: raw_covered (tools/ship_check.py:540-559) recounts any lines with the right indices; it never checks a grouped line's seed against noisefloor.recovery.e0_glmm_seed(group, i) or that every line's stamp names the artifact's environment and analysis_code, so raw files from another design or code would be recounted as valid.

non_blocking.title: Non-blocking review ids are matched by substring
non_blocking.detail: tools/ship_check.py:1194-1195 and tools/review.py test `id in log_text`, so a log that lists only N10 or N11 satisfies N1; match whole ids.

non_blocking.title: The G14 turn check accepts cap + 1 turns
non_blocking.detail: tools/budget.py:87-88 (D-037 item 2) passes agent_usage rows with claude_agent_max_turns + 1 turns; when --max-turns fails and the stream check stops the child at the first message of turn 9, a ninth turn has already started, so a one-turn overrun reads as respected; consider stopping the child when the cap-th turn ends or reporting the overrun.

non_blocking.title: G2 detects only one form of inline mypy configuration
non_blocking.detail: tools/ship_check.py:462 rejects '# mypy: ignore-errors' but not, for example, '# mypy: disable-error-code=...' in a src file, which relaxes --strict for that file while G2 still passes (no such comment exists today).

non_blocking.title: Ship-check never recomputes the derived artifacts that claims cite
non_blocking.detail: G10 re-derives claims from artifacts/e2/noise_floor.json, artifacts/method_pilots/summary.json, and artifacts/e0/crosscheck.json without checking that those files are what their scripts produce (only `make reproduce`, outside ship-check, checks some); the noise-floor and method-pilot files reproduce today (recomputed in memory).

non_blocking.title: docs/DATA.md does not list the third-party model weights
non_blocking.detail: The GGUF weights used by the pilots and E1 (Qwen3, Granite 4.0 micro, SmolLM3, Phi-4-mini, Qwen2.5) are pinned in prereg 0004 and src/noisefloor/models.py, but rule 9 asks docs/DATA.md to record source, license, and retrieval date for third-party data.

non_blocking.title: STATUS.md usage and claim counts are stale
non_blocking.detail: STATUS.md line 73 says 'review runs 0' while artifacts/usage/ledger.jsonl records this milestone review run (2026-11-11T23:42:18Z), and the G10 row says 260 claim markers where make claimcheck counts 261.

non_blocking.title: G1 still passes when the R-dependent tests the preregistrations cite are skipped
non_blocking.detail: Prereg 0006 relies on tests/test_recovery.py::test_g6_analysis_equals_the_e1_analysis and 0004 on tests/test_prereg_consistency.py, both skipped without R or rpy2; all 1,414 tests ran here (0 skipped), but in a container without R G1 would pass with them skipped, so G1 could fail on a skip of those tests.
